learning_outcomes.text: Establish the equations of electromagnetic theory for modeling wave propagation and radiation.
Obtain and manage canonical propagation solutions: plane, cylindrical, and spherical waves.
Specify the characteristics and parameters of electromagnetic propagation based on the transmission medium.
Analyze the effects of reflection and transmission of electromagnetic waves and interpret their behavior.
Establish the equations for modeling the generation and propagation of acoustic waves.
Analyze the effects of reflection and transmission of acoustic waves and interpret their behavior.
Analyze propagation modes in a guided system.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of TLs in permanent sinusoidal regime
Study and characterization of transmission lines (Project 1)
Solution of Plane Waves (PWs) to Maxwell's equations
Incidence of PWs on flat obstacles
teaching_methods: Relating theoretical concepts to analytical results
assessment_rules: The final grade for the ordinary call is calculated as: 0.13*P1 + 0.13*P2 + 0.04*P3 + 0.7*EX. The extraordinary call consists of a single exam evaluating all course content. The qualification for this call will be the one obtained in said exam. For differentiated evaluation, the procedure will be adapted according to the University of Oviedo regulations. In cases of doubt about authorship or unauthorized means, a student's in-person defense may be requested.
